title: The stress campaign's start line and its coverage measure
note: D-2026-91. The six-process scheduler campaign is the test that found the retry-budget and reconcile races (X6, X10), and it is only as good as two instruments of its own: a start line that makes the race a race, and a measure of what the campaign exercised. SC1-SC7 attack the start line on both sides -- a worker that does not wait, or waits in name only; a parent that releases early or on the first arrival; a line that never fills, or a worker that died, reported as anything but what it is. CV1-CV5 attack the coverage measure: judged on EDGES out of DISPATCHED, never on destination labels, never by repetition, never on another machine's records. SF1-SF3 attack the order and content of the safety judgement, which runs before any vacuity verdict so a thin run can never hide an unsafe one.

mutations.name: SC1_the_stress_worker_skips_the_start_line
mutations.rationale: the campaign worker neither announces nor waits, so the campaign's concurrency is whatever overlap spawn timing leaves -- the defect D-2026-91 records

mutations.name: SC2_the_stress_worker_announces_but_does_not_wait
mutations.replace:
rng = random.Random(seed)
    Path(f"{go}.ready").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (Path(f"{go}.ready") / uuid.uuid4().hex).write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    done = refused = 0
mutations.rationale: a bypass that fills the line without honouring it: the worker says it is at the line and starts at once

mutations.name: SC3_the_parent_releases_without_waiting
mutations.rationale: the release no longer waits for anyone, which is the old timed line with the timer set to zero

mutations.name: SC4_the_line_fills_at_the_first_arrival
mutations.rationale: one arrival releases everyone, so the late workers find the race already under way

mutations.name: SC5_a_worker_never_announces
mutations.rationale: the announcement half of the line is gone; a line that never fills must fail, not start

mutations.name: SC6_a_line_that_never_fills_starts_anyway
mutations.find:
if time.monotonic() > deadline:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"{_arrivals(tmp_path)} of {expected} workers reached the "
                f"start line within {START_TIMEOUT_S} s")
mutations.rationale: giving up releases whoever turned up -- a sequential race reported as a concurrent one

mutations.name: SC7_a_worker_that_died_early_is_hidden
mutations.rationale: a worker that died before the line surfaces only as a line that never filled, not as its own error

mutations.name: CV1_no_way_off_the_ordinary_path_is_required
mutations.rationale: a campaign of enqueue, dispatch and success alone passes as exercising contention

mutations.name: CV2_any_event_type_counts_as_scheduler_coverage
mutations.find:
return Counter((e.payload["src"], e.payload["dst"]) for e in events
                   if e.action == ACT_JOB_TRANSITION)
mutations.replace:
return Counter((e.payload.get("src"), e.payload.get("dst"))
                   for e in events)
mutations.rationale: a task or authority record shaped like a requeue is counted as one

mutations.name: CV3_labels_not_edges
mutations.replace: if not {d for _, d in seen} & {d for _, d in RECOVERY_EDGES}:
mutations.rationale: coverage judged on destination labels again -- the measurement D-2026-91 replaced, inverted: READY reached on the ordinary path now passes for a requeue

mutations.name: CV4_repetition_counts_as_diversity
mutations.rationale: the ordinary path taken often enough passes for recovery

mutations.name: CV5_the_ordinary_path_is_not_required
mutations.find:
problems = [f"never recorded {src} -> {dst}"
                for src, dst in ORDINARY_EDGES if (src, dst) not in seen]
mutations.rationale: a campaign that never dispatched or never succeeded is judged only on its failures

mutations.name: SF1_vacuity_is_judged_before_safety
mutations.find:
unsafe = _safety_problems(jobs)
    assert not unsafe, "UNSAFE: " + "; ".join(unsafe)
    # ANTI-VACUITY. Most operations are legitimately refused -- a dispatch
    # of a job somebody else is running, a renewal of a lease that lapsed --
    # so a ratio would be an arbitrary line. What must be true is that the
    # campaign happened: every worker got work in, the log grew, and the
    # queue took the ordinary path AND a way off it.
    assert all(d > 0 for d in per_worker.values()), (
        f"VACUOUS: a worker recorded nothing at all: {per_worker}")
    assert records > len(per_worker) * 10, (
        f"VACUOUS: the log grew by only {records} records under "
        f"{attempted} attempted operations")
    thin = _coverage_problems(edges)
    assert not thin, "VACUOUS: " + "; ".join(thin)
mutations.replace:
# ANTI-VACUITY. Most operations are legitimately refused -- a dispatch
    # of a job somebody else is running, a renewal of a lease that lapsed --
    # so a ratio would be an arbitrary line. What must be true is that the
    # campaign happened: every worker got work in, the log grew, and the
    # queue took the ordinary path AND a way off it.
    assert all(d > 0 for d in per_worker.values()), (
        f"VACUOUS: a worker recorded nothing at all: {per_worker}")
    assert records > len(per_worker) * 10, (
        f"VACUOUS: the log grew by only {records} records under "
        f"{attempted} attempted operations")
    thin = _coverage_problems(edges)
    assert not thin, "VACUOUS: " + "; ".join(thin)
    unsafe = _safety_problems(jobs)
    assert not unsafe, "UNSAFE: " + "; ".join(unsafe)
mutations.rationale: the old order: a history that is both unsafe and thin is reported as thin, and the budget violation goes unsaid

mutations.name: SF2_the_retry_budget_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the campaign stops checking the property that found X6 -- a job attempted past its budget

mutations.name: SF3_a_holderless_dispatch_is_accepted
mutations.find: if job.state is JobState.DISPATCHED and not job.lease_holder:
mutations.rationale: a DISPATCHED job with no lease holder -- a lease nobody owns -- is accepted
